name: THE SINDH SERVICE TRIBUNALS (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Service Tribunals (Second Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Sindh Service Tribunals Act, 1973.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Sindh Service Tribunals Act, 1973 regarding tribunal composition and appointment terms.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Service Tribunals Act, 1973 to specify the composition of a Tribunal. It mandates that a Tribunal consists of a Chairman and two Members appointed by the Government in consultation with the Chief Justice of the High Court of Sindh. The appointment is limited to a period of not more than two years for one time only.

name: (REGULARIZATION OF CONTINGENT PAID OR WORK-CHARGED EMPLOYEES OF LEFT BANK OUTFALL DRAINAGE (LOBOD) ACT, 2018

metadata.short_title: The Sindh (Regularization of Contingent Paid or Work-Charged Employees of Left Bank Outfall Drainage (LBOD) Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for regularization of the services of employees appointed on contingent or work-charged basis in the Left Bank Outfall Drainage (LBOD) of Irrigation Department of Government of Sindh.
metadata.one_line: This Act regularizes contingent and work-charged employees of the LBOD Irrigation Department as civil servants.
metadata.summary: The Act provides for the regularization of services for employees appointed on a contingent or work-charged basis in the Left Bank Outfall Drainage (LBOD) of the Irrigation Department. It deems eligible employees validly appointed as civil servants on a regular basis from the date of commencement, subject to scrutiny by a Special Committee regarding qualifications and experience. The Special Committee is headed by the Secretary of the Irrigation Department with members from the department and the Services Wing.

metadata.short_title: The Sind Adaptation of Laws Order, 1975

The Karachi Essential Articles (Price Control and Anti-Hoarding) Act, 1953
The Co-operative Societies (Repayment of Loans) Ordinance, 1960
The Sind Private Colleges (Management and Control) Ordinance, 1970
The Land Acquisition (West Pakistan Amendment) (Repeal) Ordinance, 1971
The Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1972

The Universities and Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Malpractices Act, 1950
metadata.one_line: An Order adapting federal and provincial laws to apply to the Province of Sind by substituting relevant authorities.
metadata.summary: This Order adapts existing Federal and Provincial laws to bring them into accord with the Constitution for the Province of Sind. It substitutes references to 'Central Government' with 'Federal Government', 'West Pakistan' with 'Sind', and 'Province' with 'Province of Sind' where necessary. The adaptations include modifications, additions, omissions, and substitutions throughout various Acts and Ordinances listed in the Schedule.

name: AGA KHAN PROPERTIES (SUCCESSION AND TRANSFER) ACT, 2025

metadata.short_title: The Aga Khan Properties (Succession and Transfer) Act, 2025
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for automatic and undisputed succession and transfer of properties of Aga Khan to the successor of Aga Khan of the Shia Imami Ismaili Muslims.
metadata.territorial_extent: the whole of the Province of Sindh
metadata.commencement: at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from the 4 February 2025
metadata.administering_body: Board of Revenue of Government of Sindh
metadata.one_line: This Act provides for the automatic succession and transfer of Aga Khan's properties in Sindh to his successor without legal formalities.
metadata.summary: The Act ensures the automatic and undisputed succession of properties owned by the Aga Khan to his successor within the Province of Sindh. It eliminates the need for probate, succession certificates, or court orders for these specific properties. The legislation mandates that all relevant authorities update records to reflect the successor as the lawful owner immediately upon the Aga Khan's demise.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 2025.
metadata.commencement: at once and deemed to have taken effect on the 1st day of January, 2025
amends: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 2025
repeals: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2025
subjects: substitution of dates in tax acts
metadata.one_line: Amends the Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 2025 regarding tax rates and schedule amendments while repealing a 2025 Ordinance.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 2025 to adjust applicable tax rates for a specific period and substitute dates in section 5. It grants the Government power to amend tax schedules via notification during any financial year, subject to laying the notification before the Provincial Assembly of Sindh. Additionally, the Act repeals the Sindh Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2025.

metadata.short_title: The Al-Kawthar University Act, 2023
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the University known as the AL-KAWTHAR University at Karachi and to provide for matters ancillary thereto.
metadata.one_line: Establishes the AL-Kawthar University in Karachi and defines its authorities, officers, and governing statutes.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the AL-Kawthar University at Karachi as a body corporate owned by Education For You (Private) Limited. It outlines the structure of the university's authorities, including the Board of Governors, Academic Council, and various committees for finance, affiliation, and discipline. The legislation also defines key terms, sets out the powers and functions of officers, and provides for the creation of a University Fund.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Arid Zone Development Authority Act, 1985
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the Sindh Arid Zone Development Authority.
repeals: Sindh Ordinance III of 1985
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Sindh Arid Zone Development Authority to manage arid zone areas and related funds.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Arid Zone Development Authority as a body corporate to manage development in declared arid zones. The Authority consists of the Chief Minister as Chairman, along with official and non-official members appointed by the Government. It outlines the powers, functions, finance, audit, and accounts of the Authority, including the collection of betterment fees. The Act also provides for offences, government control over proceedings, and the dissolution of the Authority.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Charities Registration and Regulation Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to register and regulate charities and collection and utilization of charitable funds.
repeals: Charitable Funds (Regulation of Collections) Act, 1953
metadata.one_line: This Act establishes a Commission to register and regulate charities and the collection of charitable funds in Sindh.
metadata.summary: The Sindh Charities Registration and Regulation Act, 2019 provides for the registration, administration, and regulation of charities within the province. It defines key terms such as 'charity', 'charitable fund', and 'charitable purpose' to include a wide range of social activities. The Act establishes the Charities Registration and Regulation Commission to oversee these functions and mandates proper accounting, auditing, and monitoring of charitable funds.

name: CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017

metadata.short_title: The Code of Criminal Procedure (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898, in its application to the Province of Sindh.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 for Sindh by substituting terms related to district administration.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 as it applies to the Province of Sindh. It substitutes references to 'Zila Nazim' with 'Provincial Government or its authorized officer' and updates police-related titles in specific sections. Additionally, it omits sub-section (7) of section 144.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Employees Old-Age Benefits (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Sindh Employees Old-Age Benefits Act, 2014.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Sindh Employees Old-Age Benefits Act, 2014 by changing a specific clause in section 7.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Employees Old-Age Benefits Act, 2014. Specifically, it substitutes the word 'two' with 'four' in clauses (c) and (d) of subsection (1) of section 7 of the 2014 Act. The amendment came into force immediately upon enactment.

name: EVACUEE TRUST PROPERTIES (MANAGEMENT AND DISPOSAL) ACT, 2019

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Evacuee Trust Properties (Management and Disposal) Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the management and disposal of evacuee properties attached to charitable, religious or educational trusts or institutions.
metadata.territorial_extent: the whole of the Province of Sindh
repeals: The Evacuee Trust Properties (Management and Disposal) Act, 1975
metadata.one_line: This Act establishes a Board to manage and dispose of evacuee trust properties in Sindh attached to charitable, religious, or educational institutions.
metadata.summary: The Sindh Evacuee Trust Properties (Management and Disposal) Act, 2019 provides for the management and disposal of evacuee properties attached to charitable, religious, or educational trusts or institutions within the Province of Sindh. It establishes a Board consisting of various members including representatives from the Provincial Assembly, Government departments, and civil society to oversee these properties. The Board has powers to maintain records, prepare budgets, buy surplus income, sell or transfer properties, and assess rents, subject to Government approval.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Explosives (Repeal) Act, 2024
metadata.long_title: An Act to repeal the Sindh Explosives Act, 2019.
repeals: Sindh Explosives Act, 2019
metadata.status_evidence: The Sindh Explosives Act, 2019 (Sindh Act No.XXVIII of 2023) is hereby repealed.
metadata.one_line: This Act repeals the Sindh Explosives Act, 2019 and comes into force immediately.
metadata.summary: The Sindh Explosives (Repeal) Act, 2024 is a short legislative instrument enacted by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh. Its sole purpose is to repeal the existing Sindh Explosives Act, 2019 (Sindh Act No.XXVIII of 2023). The Act was promulgated on June 2, 2025, and it comes into force at once upon enactment.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Factories (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Sindh Factories Act, 2015.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Sindh Factories Act, 2015 to replace terms like 'woman or child' with 'adolescent' and add transport rules for women workers.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Factories Act, 2015 to update terminology regarding female and young workers. It substitutes the phrase 'woman or child' with 'adolescent' in specific sections of the parent Act. Additionally, it introduces provisions for safe transportation facilities for women working late at night and allows the government to vary working hour limits for seasonal factories.

metadata.short_title: The Forest (Sind Amendment) Act, 1972
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Forest Act, 1927, in its application to the Province of Sind.
repeals: The Forest (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.one_line: Amends the Forest Act, 1927 for Sindh by updating magistrate titles, compensation limits, fines, and adding police assistance provisions.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Forest Act, 1927 as it applies to the Province of Sind. It substitutes specific terms in sections 67, 68, and 71 regarding magistrate titles, forest officer ranks, compensation limits, and fines for various animals. Additionally, it adds a new section 79-A authorizing Forest officers to requisition police assistance and repeals the corresponding Ordinance from 1972.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Immunization and Epidemics Control Act, 2023
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the prevention and control of diseases and epidemics in the province of Sindh through immunization, vaccination, scientific and social means and methods.
metadata.territorial_extent: the whole of the Sindh Province
repeals: The West Pakistan Vaccination Ordinance, 1958
metadata.max_penalty: imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to Hundred Thousand Rupees, or with both
metadata.one_line: This Act provides for disease prevention and epidemic control in Sindh via immunization and vaccination measures.
metadata.summary: The Sindh Immunization and Epidemics Control Act, 2023 consolidates laws relating to immunization and epidemic control within the province of Sindh. It imposes duties on local authorities and parents/guardians to ensure vaccination, establishes epidemic committees and cells, and outlines specific vaccination schedules for children and women. The Act also defines key terms, sets penalties for contraventions such as obstructing vaccination programs or propagating against immunization measures, and repeals the West Pakistan Vaccination Ordinance, 1958.

name: INSTITUTE OF ADVANCED ENDOSCOPY AND GASTROENTEROLOGY ACT, 2021

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Institute of Advanced Endoscopy and Gastroenterology Act, 2021
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of an Institute known as the Sindh Institute of Advanced Endoscopy and Gastroenterology at Karachi.
establishes: Sindh Institute of Advanced Endoscopy and Gastroenterology
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Sindh Institute of Advanced Endoscopy and Gastroenterology at Karachi for medical training.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Institute of Advanced Endoscopy and Gastroenterology at Karachi to address complex gastroenterological diseases. It reorganizes an existing institute into a body corporate with perpetual succession, transferring its properties and staff to the new entity. The Act defines the governance structure including a Board of Governors, Academic Council, and Executive Director, while outlining functions such as training medics, managing funds, and fostering international cooperation.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of an Institute known as the Sindh Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases.
metadata.territorial_extent: the whole of the Province of Sindh
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Sindh Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases in Karachi or Sukkur for treating cardiovascular diseases and conducting research.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases with its headquarters in Karachi or Sukkur. The Institute functions to provide modern treatment, conduct research, train medical personnel, and develop into a center of excellence for cardiovascular disease management. It creates a Governing Body comprising government officials, civil society members, and ex-officio representatives to supervise the Institute's administration.

name: INSTITUTE OF MOTHER AND CHILD HEALTH ACT, 2023.

metadata.short_title: The Institute of Mother and Child Health Act, 2023
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of an Institute known as the Institute of Mother and Child Health at District Shaheed Benazirabad (Nawabshah).
establishes: Institute of Mother and Child Health
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Institute of Mother and Child Health in Nawabshah for medical training, research, and treatment.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Institute of Mother and Child Health at District Shaheed Benazirabad (Nawabshah) as a body corporate. The Institute functions as an independent hub for awarding degrees, conducting trainings in gynecology, obstetrics, pediatrics, and neonatology, and providing advanced treatment. It is affiliated with the Peoples University of Medical and Health Sciences for Women and aims to reduce infant mortality and malnutrition while fostering research and international cooperation.

name: INSTITUTE OF MUSIC AND PERFORMING ART ACT, 2021

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Institute of Music and Performing Art Act, 2021
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of an Institute for imparting training to young people in vocal, instrumental music and performing arts known as the Sindh Institute of Music and Performing Art.
establishes: Sindh Institute of Music and Performing Art
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Sindh Institute of Music and Performing Art to train young people in music and performing arts.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Institute of Music and Performing Art as a body corporate with headquarters at Jamshoro. The Institute is administered by a Board consisting of official and non-official members appointed by the Chief Minister. It has powers to manage property, appoint staff, frame regulations, and prepare annual reports for the Government of Sindh.

name: INSTITUTE OF OPHTHALMOLOGY AND VISUAL SCIENCES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2019

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences Act, 2013.
amends: The Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences Act, 2013
metadata.one_line: Amends the 2013 Act to rename leadership, add degree-awarding powers, and expand institute functions.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences Act, 2013 to update its title and scope. It designates the institute as an independent degree-awarding body capable of offering undergraduate and postgraduate programs in ophthalmology. The amendment also expands the Board's composition, authorizes the establishment of satellite centers across Sindh, and transfers Eye Hospital Khairpur to the institute.

name: INSTITUTE OF TRAUMATOLOGY ORTHOPEDICS AND REHABILITATION ACT, 2017

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Institute of Traumatology, Orthopedics and Rehabilitation Act, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of an Institute known as the Sindh Institute of Traumatology, Orthopedics and Rehabilitation at Karachi.
establishes: Sindh Institute of Traumatology, Orthopedics and Rehabilitation
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Sindh Institute of Traumatology, Orthopedics and Rehabilitation at Karachi for treatment, research, and education.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Institute of Traumatology, Orthopedics and Rehabilitation at Karachi as a body corporate. The Institute is tasked with providing orthopedic treatment, conducting research, and offering postgraduate teaching programs in collaboration with relevant medical bodies. It manages its own funds through investments and donations while maintaining accounts under the supervision of the Board and Government.

name: JINNAH POSTGRADUATE MEDICAL CENTER AND NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF CHILD HEALTH, KARACHI (REGULATION AND MANAGEMENT) ACT, 2026

metadata.short_title: The Jinnah Postgraduate Medical Center and National Institute of Child Health, Karachi (Regulation and Management) Act, 2026
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for regulation and management of the Jinnah Postgraduate Medical Center (JPMC), Karachi and National Institute of Child Health (NICH), Karachi.
establishes: Board of Governments of the Centre and Institute
metadata.one_line: This Act regulates and manages JPMC and NICH Karachi under a Federal-Sindh agreement.
metadata.summary: The Act provides for the regulation and management of the Jinnah Postgraduate Medical Center and National Institute of Child Health in Karachi. It establishes a Board to oversee operations, defines the relationship between the institutions and the Government of Sindh under an existing Agreement, and outlines provisions for staff deputation, fund management, and academic governance. The Act ensures that all administrative affairs are overseen by the Department while respecting policies set by the Board.

metadata.short_title: The Karachi Metropolitan University Act, 2023
metadata.long_title: An Act to reconstitute and reorganize the Karachi Medical and Dental College and Abbasi Shaheed Hospital, Karachi as the Karachi Metropolitan University.
repeals: The notifications, legislative instruments constituting the Centre of Excellence in Arts and Design, Mehran University of Engineering and Technology, Jamshoro
metadata.one_line: This Act reconstitutes the Karachi Medical and Dental College and Abbasi Shaheed Hospital as the Karachi Metropolitan University.
metadata.summary: The Karachi Metropolitan University Act, 2023 was enacted to reconstitute and reorganize the Karachi Medical and Dental College and Abbasi Shaheed Hospital into a new university entity. It establishes the governance structure including the Senate, Syndicate, and Academic Council, along with various committees for finance, affiliation, and discipline. The Act also defines key terms related to university officers, affiliated colleges, and educational institutions within Sindh.

metadata.short_title: The Land Acquisition (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, in its application to the Province of Sindh.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 regarding officer ranks and court references in Sindh.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 specifically for its application to the Province of Sindh. It inserts a rank requirement for officers under section 3 and adds 'and Collector' to references in section 23. The legislation came into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Sindh Land Revenue Act, 1967.
establishes: Centralized Digital Land Record Management System
key_definitions: Centralized Digital Land Recorded Management System
metadata.one_line: Amends the Sindh Land Revenue Act, 1967 to introduce digital land records and electronic transfer systems.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Land Revenue Act, 1967 to facilitate the digitalization of land records and the electronic transfer of title. It introduces new definitions for terms such as 'audit trail mechanism', 'biometric verification', and 'Centralized Digital Land Record Management System'. The legislation empowers the Government to designate authorities to manage these electronic systems and mandates a transition from manual to digital record management in specified areas.

metadata.short_title: The Larkana Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Larkana Development Authority (Revival and Amending) Act, 2013.
amends: The Larkana Development Authority (Revival and Amending) Act, 2013
metadata.one_line: Amends the Larkana Development Authority Act to change Chairman composition requirements.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Larkana Development Authority (Revival and Amending) Act, 2013. It substitutes clauses in section 4 regarding the Chairman's composition. The changes require one Local Member or eminent person nominated by Government and one prominent lady with a background in Social welfare and Women Development.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013 by substituting references to the Council with the Chief Executive of the Council in section 26.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013 to update terminology regarding local governance structures. Specifically, it substitutes references to 'the Council' and 'Government' with 'the Chief Executive of the Council' and 'Secretary, Local Government' respectively within section 26. The legislation was passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on February 7, 2019, and received assent from the Governor on February 20, 2019. It came into force immediately upon publication.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Mass Transit Authority (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Sindh Mass Transit Authority Act, 2014.
metadata.max_penalty: such fines as may be prescribed by rules
metadata.one_line: Amends the Sindh Mass Transit Authority Act, 2014 to add AFC systems, licensing powers, and new offences regarding fare evasion.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Mass Transit Authority Act, 2014 to expand the powers of developers and operators. It mandates the installation of auto fare collection (AFC) systems and grants authority to impose fines for non-compliance. The legislation also introduces specific offences for unauthorized entry into stations or failure to pay fares, allowing authorized officers to recover fines through court complaints.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Maternity Benefits Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide safeguards to working women's maternity benefits, proper child nursing and job security in public and private organisations.
metadata.territorial_extent: the whole of the Province of Sindh
metadata.one_line: Provides maternity benefits, leave, and job security safeguards for working women in Sindh.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes safeguards for working women's maternity benefits, proper child nursing, and job security within public and private organizations in Sindh. It mandates specific periods of paid leave for pregnancy, delivery, miscarriage, still-birth, premature delivery, and medical complications. The legislation also requires employers to provide nursing breaks, establish day care facilities for eligible employees, and pay full wages during the maternity period.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Medicolegal Act, 2023
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the regulation of medicolegal system including administration, and all medicolegal examinations and postmortems conducted in the Province of Sindh.
metadata.territorial_extent: the whole of the Province of Sindh
metadata.max_penalty: imprisonment which may extend to six months or a fine not less than one hundred thousand rupees, or with both
metadata.one_line: Regulates the medicolegal system, examinations, and postmortems in Sindh while establishing specific boards and directorates.
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the medicolegal system within the Province of Sindh, covering administration, examinations, and postmortems. It establishes key bodies including the Sindh Medicolegal Advisory Board, the Sindh Medicolegal Directorate, and the Sindh Institute of Forensic Medicine. The legislation defines various roles such as Judicial Medical Officers and Forensic Nurses, sets standards for forensic evidence collection, and outlines penalties for contraventions.

metadata.short_title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.long_title: An Act to further amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to introduce automated enforcement, demerit points, and traffic courts.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to incorporate modern traffic management technologies like ANPR cameras. It introduces a mandatory pre-license driver training requirement for heavy and light transport vehicles and establishes a demerit point system for various traffic violations. Additionally, it designates Judicial Magistrate Courts as exclusive Traffic Courts and mandates the settlement of penalties before driving licenses can be updated.

name: NEW CAPTIVE POWER PLANTS SUBSIDY ACT, 2017

metadata.short_title: The Sindh New Captive Power Plants Subsidy Act, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for tariff differential support to certain captive power producers in the Province of Sindh.
metadata.territorial_extent: all new captive power plants operating in Sindh
metadata.max_penalty: fine not less than five million rupees and not exceeding ten million rupees
metadata.one_line: Provides tariff differential support to new captive power producers in Sindh to alleviate energy consumer suffering.
metadata.summary: This Act provides tariff differential support to new captive power producers in the Province of Sindh who are facing economic non-viability due to regulatory tariff fixes. It aims to alleviate the suffering of industrial, commercial, and residential consumers caused by acute power shortages and load shedding. The Government is empowered to pay the calculated subsidy within thirty days upon receipt of certified invoices and accounts from a Chartered Accountant.

name: NIBD POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF LIFE SCIENCES ACT, 2014.

metadata.short_title: The NIBD Post Graduate Institute of Life Sciences Act, 2014
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of an Institute known as the NIBD Post Graduate Institute of Life Sciences.
repeals: The NIBD Post Graduate Institute of Life Sciences Ordinance, 2013
establishes: NIBD Post Graduate Institute of Life Sciences
metadata.one_line: Establishes the NIBD Post Graduate Institute of Life Sciences for postgraduate teaching and research in life sciences.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the NIBD Post Graduate Institute of Life Sciences as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the Institute powers to conduct postgraduate programs, undertake research in medical and life sciences, and award degrees. The Act defines various authorities including the Board of Governors, Academic Council, and Director, outlining their functions and appointment processes.

metadata.short_title: The Pakistan University, Karachi Act, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the Pakistan University, Karachi.
metadata.administering_body: Dr. Nasim A. Khan Education Foundation
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Pakistan University, Karachi as a body corporate owned by the Dr. Nasim A. Khan Education Foundation.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan University, Karachi as an autonomous body corporate owned and managed by the Dr. Nasim A. Khan Education Foundation. It defines the structure of the university, including the Board of Governors, Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and various committees such as the Academic Council and Finance and Planning Committee. The legislation outlines the powers to provide instruction, award degrees, manage property, and establish campuses within or outside Pakistan.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Prisons and Corrections Services (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Sindh Prisons and Corrections Services Act, 2019.
amends: Sindh Prisons and Corrections Services Act, 2019
repeals: The Sindh Prisons and Corrections Services (Amendment) Ordinance, 2025
metadata.one_line: Amends the Sindh Prisons and Corrections Services Act, 2019 regarding officer appointments and repeals a 2025 Ordinance.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Prisons and Corrections Services Act, 2019 to update appointment procedures for various prison service ranks. It substitutes specific sections of the 2019 Act to define the appointing authority (Chief Minister or Minister) and eligibility criteria for Deputy Inspector General, Assistant Inspector General, and Officer In-Charge positions. Additionally, the Act repeals the Sindh Prisons and Corrections Services (Amendment) Ordinance, 2025.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Prisons and Corrections Services Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to consolidate and reform the law relating to Prisons and Correctional facilities and correction and rehabilitation of Prisoners in Sindh, and to provide a policy for regulating such matters; AND WHEREAS it is expedient to make provision for the establishment, management, control and security of Prisons and Correctional facilities, the custody and welfare of prisoners and for related matters
metadata.territorial_extent: whole of the Province of Sindh
repeals: Prisons Act, 1894
Prisoners Act, 1900
metadata.max_penalty: imprisonment subject to evidence or enquiry in the manner as prescribed
metadata.one_line: This Act consolidates and reforms laws regarding prisons, correctional facilities, and prisoner rehabilitation in Sindh.
metadata.summary: The Sindh Prisons and Corrections Services Act, 2019 consolidates and reforms the legal framework governing prisons and correctional facilities within the province of Sindh. It establishes policies for the management, security, custody, and welfare of prisoners while emphasizing their fundamental rights and rehabilitation. The Act outlines basic principles for treating prisoners with dignity, mandates reformation programs, and creates specific bodies such as the Prison Policy Board and an Implementation Committee to oversee initial operations.

name: PROHIBITION OF INTEREST ON PRIVATE LOANS ACT, 2023.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Prohibition of Interest on Private Loans Act, 2023
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the prohibition of the business and practices of private money-lending and advancing loans and transactions based on interest, in the Province of Sindh.
metadata.territorial_extent: the whole of the Province of Sindh
metadata.max_penalty: imprisonment up to ten years and fine not exceeding one million rupees
metadata.one_line: This Act prohibits private money lending and interest-based transactions in Sindh to align with Islamic injunctions.
metadata.summary: The Sindh Prohibition of Interest on Private Loans Act, 2023 aims to ban the business and practices of private money-lending and advancing loans based on interest within the Province of Sindh. It defines key terms such as 'money lender', 'interest', and 'loan or debt' while establishing severe penalties for contravention, including imprisonment up to ten years and fines. The Act also provides mechanisms for borrowers to recover debts without paying interest, prohibits harassment of debtors, and ensures that its provisions override any conflicting laws.

name: PROTECTION OF JOURNALISTS AND OTHER MEDIA PRACTITIONERS ACT, 2021

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Protection of Journalists and Other Media Practitioners Act, 2021
metadata.long_title: An Act to promote, protect and effectively ensure the independence, impartiality, safety, and freedom of expression of journalists and other media practitioners.
metadata.territorial_extent: the whole of the Province of Sindh
establishes: Sindh Commission for the Protection of Journalists and Media Practitioners
metadata.one_line: This Act promotes and protects the safety, independence, and freedom of expression of journalists in Sindh.
metadata.summary: The Sindh Protection of Journalists and Other Media Practitioners Act, 2021 establishes a legal framework to safeguard the rights of journalists and media practitioners within the Province of Sindh. It mandates the Government to ensure their life, safety, and security while protecting their professional sources from disclosure. The Act creates the Sindh Commission for the Protection of Journalists and Media Practitioners to oversee these protections and defines various terms related to journalism and harassment.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Public Procurement (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Sindh Public Procurement Act, 2009.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Sindh Public Procurement Act, 2009 to grant government power for national interest exemptions.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Public Procurement Act, 2009 to empower the Government to grant exemptions from procurement regulations. Such exemptions apply to objects or classes of objects deemed necessary in the national interest. The Authority may recommend these exemptions to the Government, which then decides whether to exempt specific items from the operation of the Act and related rules.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 2022
metadata.long_title: An Act to repeal the Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989 (Sindh Act No. XI of 1989) and with certain modifications, re-enact the Sindh Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978 (Sindh Ordinance VI of 1978) as a new law.
amends: The Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989 (Sindh Act No. XI of 1989)
The Sindh Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978 (Sindh Ordinance VI of 1978)
repeals: The Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989
metadata.one_line: This Act establishes the Sindh Public Service Commission, repeals the 1989 Act, and re-enacts the 1978 Ordinance with modifications.
metadata.summary: The Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 2022 establishes a Public Service Commission for the Province of Sindh. It repeals the Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989, and re-enacts the Sindh Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978 with certain modifications. The Act defines the composition, appointment, terms, conditions, removal, and functions of the Commission, including provisions for rules and regulations.

name: REGULARIZATION OF CONTRACT EMPLOYEES OF KHAIRPUR MEDICAL COLLEGE, KHAIRPUR) ACT, 2018

metadata.short_title: The Sindh (Regularization of Contract Employees of Khairpur Medical College, Khairpur) Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for regularization of the services of employees appointed on contract basis in the Khairpur Medical College, Khairpur.
metadata.one_line: This Act regularizes contract employees at Khairpur Medical College as civil servants subject to committee scrutiny.
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for employees appointed on a contract basis in the Khairpur Medical College, Khairpur. It deems such employees holding appointments immediately before commencement to be validly appointed as civil servants on a regular basis. The orders of regularization are subject to scrutiny and clearance by a Special Committee regarding academic qualifications, experience, age, and domicile.

name: REGULARIZATION OF VETERINARY DOCTORS APPOINTED ON CONTRACT BASIS ACT, 2018.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Regularization of Veterinary Doctors Appointed on Contract Basis Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the regularization of the services of certain doctors appointed on contract basis under district-wise Veterinary Service Program of livestock and Fishries Department, Government of Sindh.
key_definitions: appointment of a Veterinary Doctor on contract
metadata.administering_body: Livestock and Fisheries Department, Government of Sindh
metadata.one_line: This Act regularizes veterinary doctors appointed on contract basis in the district-wise Veterinary Service Program as civil servants.
metadata.summary: The Act provides for the regularization of services for veterinary doctors who were appointed on a contract basis under the district-wise Veterinary Service Program. It deems these doctors to have been validly appointed as civil servants on a regular basis from the date of the Act's commencement, provided they possess the prescribed qualifications. The legislation also stipulates that no doctor shall be transferred from their district unless a replacement is available.

name: REGULATION OF AESTHETIC AND LASER TREATMENT ACT, 2018

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Regulation of Aesthetic and Laser Treatment Act, 2018
metadata.long_title: An Act To provide for regulations of laser and aesthetic treatments.
metadata.max_penalty: Imprisonment up to Six Months or a fine of not less than Rs. 100,000/= and up to Rs. 500,000/=
metadata.one_line: Regulates laser and aesthetic treatments in Sindh to ensure safety and prevent fraudulent practices.
metadata.summary: This Act provides regulations for laser and aesthetic skin treatments in establishments within Sindh. It defines key terms such as medical professionals and treatment centers, mandating on-site supervision by qualified dermatologists or plastic surgeons. The legislation strictly controls the sale of aesthetic equipment, requiring specific licenses and affidavits from buyers. Violations result in penalties including license termination, sealing of treatment centers, fines, and imprisonment.

name: REGULATION OF ELECTRIC POWER SERVICES ACT, 2023.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Regulation of Electric Power Services Act, 2023
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the regulation of electric power services within the Province of Sindh and matters connected therewith and incidental thereto
metadata.territorial_extent: the whole of Province of Sindh
metadata.one_line: This Act establishes the Sindh Electric Power Regulatory Authority to regulate electric power services, licences, and tariffs in Sindh.
metadata.summary: The Sindh Regulation of Electric Power Services Act, 2023 provides a legal framework for regulating electric power services within the Province of Sindh. It establishes the Sindh Electric Power Regulatory Authority (the Authority) and defines its powers, functions, and decision-making processes. The Act covers various aspects including generation, distribution, supply licences, tariff determination, captive generation, microgrids, and dispute resolution mechanisms.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Removal from Service (Special Powers) (Repeal) Act, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Act to repeal the Sindh Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000.
repeals: Sindh Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000
subjects: sindh civil efficiency and discipline rules
metadata.one_line: This Act repeals the Sindh Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000 and restores applicable disciplinary laws.
metadata.summary: The Sindh Removal from Service (Special Powers) (Repeal) Act, 2017 was enacted to repeal the Sindh Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000. It extends to the whole of Sindh and comes into force immediately upon enactment. Upon repeal, all pending proceedings continue under the repealed Ordinance until its provisions are no longer applicable, after which disciplinary matters for government servants revert to the Civil Servants Act, 1973 and related rules.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Reproductive Healthcare Rights Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to facilitate reproductive healthcare and promote reproductive health rights in the Province of Sindh.
metadata.territorial_extent: the whole of the Province of Sindh
metadata.administering_body: Health and Population Departments of the Government of Sindh
metadata.one_line: An Act to facilitate reproductive healthcare and promote reproductive health rights in Sindh.
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates reproductive healthcare and promotes reproductive health rights within the Province of Sindh. It establishes basic principles such as acceptance of facts, promotion of information, gender neutrality, equality, and freedom from discrimination or ill treatment. The Health and Population Departments are responsible for oversight and implementation through public sector organizations and partnerships.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Shops and Commercial Establishment (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Sindh Shops and Commercial Establishment Act, 2015.
amends: The Sindh Shops and Commercial Establishment Act, 2015
metadata.one_line: Amends the 2015 Act to add washing facilities requirements and regulate women's working hours with transport provisions.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Shops and Commercial Establishment Act, 2015 to introduce new protections for female workers. It mandates adequate washing facilities in every establishment and regulates working hours beyond 7:00 PM for women. The amendment requires employer consent and arranged transport for late-night shifts.

name: SIND MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ACT, 1975

metadata.short_title: The Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the salaries, allowances and privileges of the Ministers including Chief Minister.
repeals: The Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1972
metadata.one_line: This Act provides salaries, allowances, and privileges for Ministers and the Chief Minister in Sindh.
metadata.summary: The Act establishes the financial terms and official privileges for the Chief Minister and Ministers of Sindh. It covers salaries, various allowances such as sumptuary and travelling expenses, official residence provisions, transport facilities, and medical benefits. The legislation also outlines perks available to former Chief Ministers who served for at least four years.

name: SIND SPEAKER’S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER’S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ACT, 1975 (codified)

metadata.short_title: The Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the salaries, allowances and privileges of Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of Sind.
repeals: The Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1972
The Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.one_line: This Act provides salaries, allowances, and privileges for the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of Sindh.
metadata.summary: This Act determines the salaries, allowances, and privileges for the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of Sindh. It covers travel expenses, official residence maintenance, transport facilities, and specific perks upon retirement. The provisions also include definitions of key terms and repeals earlier acts from 1972 and 1974.

name: SINDH CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION, FUNCTIONS AND POWERS) ACT, 2009

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2009
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for establishment of Criminal Prosecution Service in Sindh.
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Criminal Prosecution Service in Sindh and defines its constitution, functions, and powers.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service to regulate the appointment, conduct, and administration of public prosecutors within the province. It defines the hierarchy from the Prosecutor General down to Assistant District Public Prosecutors and outlines their duties regarding criminal case prosecution. The legislation also empowers the Government to establish a process serving agency and sets terms for service under the Sindh Civil Servants' Act.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Finance Act, 2025
metadata.long_title: An Act to rationalize, levy, enhance and reduce certain taxes and duties in the Province of Sindh and to amend certain laws in the Province of Sindh;
amends: section 3 of West Pakistan Act No. XXXII of 1958
section 95 of the Sindh Act No.XLII of 2013
Schedule of the Sindh Act No. XVIII of 2017
repeals: West Pakistan Act No.X of 1958
metadata.one_line: Rationalizes taxes in Sindh, amends various acts regarding vehicle insurance and services tax, and repeals the 1958 Entertainment Duty Act.
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes, levies, enhances, and reduces certain taxes and duties within the Province of Sindh. It amends several existing laws, including the Stamp Act, Motor Vehicles Act, Sales Tax on Services Act, and Local Government Act. Additionally, it repeals the West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1958, and introduces finality clauses regarding paid cess.

name: SINDH INSTITUTE OF TEACHER EDUCATION ACT, 2025

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Institute of Teacher Education Act, 2025
metadata.long_title: An Act to re-constitute and re-organize the Government College of Education, Federal B Area Block-15 Campus, Karachi and to establish a degree awarding Institute known as the Sindh Institute of Teacher Education.
metadata.one_line: This Act re-organizes a government college to establish the Sindh Institute of Teacher Education with defined authorities and functions.
metadata.summary: The Act reconstitutes and re-organizes the Government College of Education, Federal B Area Block-15 Campus, Karachi, into the Sindh Institute of Teacher Education. It establishes the Institute as a body corporate with perpetual succession and defines its officers, authorities including the Board of Governors and Academic Council, and various committees like the Discipline and Affiliation Committees. The Act also provides for the Institute Fund, statutes, regulations, rules, and general provisions regarding appointments, retirement, and jurisdiction.

name: SINDH LIVESTOCK REGISTRATION AND TRADE AUTHORITY ACT, 2017

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Livestock Registration and Trade Authority Act, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of an Authority known as the Sindh Livestock Registration and Trade Authority for the livestock registration, tagging and identification and development of the activities related to livestock products, the trade and export thereof, in the Province of Sindh.
metadata.territorial_extent: the whole of the Province of Sindh
establishes: Sindh Livestock Registration and Trade Authority
metadata.administering_body: Livestock and Fisheries Department, Government of Sindh
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Sindh Livestock Registration and Trade Authority to manage livestock registration, identification, and trade in Sindh.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Livestock Registration and Trade Authority to oversee livestock registration, tagging, and identification within the Province of Sindh. It aims to develop activities related to livestock products, trade, and exports while improving sector practices to meet international standards. The Authority is empowered to create rules and regulations covering animal health, welfare, nutrition, safety, and marketability.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Local Government (Third Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.long_title: An Act to further amend the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013.
metadata.one_line: This Act amends the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013 to include youth representation and adjust seat allocations.
metadata.summary: The Sindh Local Government (Third Amendment) Act, 2015 was enacted to further amend the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013. It introduces a new definition for 'youth' as persons below twenty-five years and mandates their inclusion in Union Committees and Councils. The Act also substitutes various clauses regarding member composition, election methods like secret ballots, and seat allocation formulas for reserved categories.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Public-Private Partnership (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Sindh Public-Private Partnership Act, 2010.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Sindh Public-Private Partnership Act, 2010 to allow arbitration outside Pakistan for specific projects.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Public-Private Partnership Act, 2010 by adding a new subsection to section 27. The amendment permits agencies or the government to agree on an arbitration seat and venue outside Pakistan for government-to-government projects under section 19-A or projects involving foreign investment/lending. This permission is subject to Board recommendation and Government approval.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Revenue Board (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Sindh Revenue Board Act, 2010.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Sindh Revenue Board Act, 2010 regarding definitions, officer appointments, and board procedures.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Revenue Board Act, 2010 to update specific definitions and operational clauses. It expands the definition of 'officer' to include those appointed under the Sales Tax on Services Act, 2011, and clarifies the meaning of 'notification'. The amendment also modifies provisions regarding the appointment of the Secretary during vacancies, increases board meeting frequency, and allows for the appointment of law officers to handle litigation. Additionally, it updates the Board's functions to include formulating HR policies and preparing internal job postings.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Zakat and Ushr (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Sindh Zakat and Ushr Act, 2011.
amends: The Sindh Zakat and Ushr Act, 2011
metadata.one_line: Amends the Sindh Zakat and Ushr Act, 2011 to allow committees to disburse funds via cross cheques or ATM.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Zakat and Ushr Act, 2011 to update the methods by which Local Zakat and Ushr Committees can disburse funds. Specifically, it substitutes section 9(3) of the parent Act to authorize the use of cross cheques, order cheques, or Auto Teller Machine (ATM) transactions for distributing Zakat funds or incurring expenditure from the Local Zakat Fund. The amendment empowers these committees to utilize such financial instruments in any other manner determined by the Council.

name: SUKKUR INSTITUTE OF BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION ACT, 2006

metadata.short_title: The Sukkur Institute of Business Administration Act, 2006
metadata.long_title: An Act to Sindh provide for the establishment of Sukkur institute of business administration.
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Sukkur Institute of Business Administration as a degree-awarding institution with academic autonomy in Sindh.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sukkur Institute of Business Administration as a body corporate with perpetual succession and a common seal. It grants the Institute academic, financial, and administrative autonomy to employ staff and manage property without external interference. The Act defines the structure of the Institute, including the Chancellor, Senate, Syndicate, and Academic Council, and outlines their respective powers and functions.

name: SUKKUR WATER AND SEWERAGE CORPORATION ACT, 2023

metadata.short_title: The Sukkur Water and Sewerage Corporation Act, 2023
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of Corporation known as the Sukkur Water and Sewerage Corporation.
metadata.territorial_extent: the concerned municipal limits of Sukkur Municipal Corporation and such additional areas as may be notified by Government
metadata.max_penalty: Imprisonment for up to five years and a fine of up to five million rupees
metadata.administering_body: Local Government and Housing Town Planning Department, Government of Sindh
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Sukkur Water and Sewerage Corporation to supply potable water and dispose of sewage in Sukkur.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sukkur Water and Sewerage Corporation to provide potable water and sewerage services within the limits of the Sukkur Municipal Corporation. It defines the Corporation's powers, management structure including a Board and Chief Executive Officer, and outlines responsibilities for infrastructure development and service delivery. The legislation also creates offences related to unauthorized water use, damage to infrastructure, and waste discharge, prescribing fines and imprisonment as penalties.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Terms of Employment (Standing Orders) (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Sindh Terms of Employment (Standing Orders) Act, 2015;
amends: The Sindh Terms of Employment (Standing Orders) Act, 2015
metadata.one_line: Amends the Sindh Terms of Employment (Standing Orders) Act, 2015 to include provisions for seasonal workers.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Terms of Employment (Standing Orders) Act, 2015 to specifically address the needs of seasonal workers. It defines 'seasonal factories' and 'seasons' within specific manufacturing processes like cotton ginning and fruit processing. The amendment adds new clauses to the Schedule regarding seasonal workers, including a requirement for them to surrender a card at the end of the season.

name: THAR COAL AND ENERGY BOARD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2025.

metadata.short_title: The Thar Coal and Energy Board (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Thar Coal and Energy Board Act, 2011.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Thar Coal and Energy Board Act, 2011 regarding functions, appointments, and validates past actions.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Thar Coal and Energy Board Act, 2011 to update the functions of the Board, including tariff determination and fee levying. It also revises the qualifications and appointment terms for the Managing Director. Additionally, the Act includes a validation clause to deem actions taken since July 6, 2011, as valid.

name: THAR COAL AND ENERGY BOARD ACT, 2011.

metadata.short_title: The Thar Coal and Energy Board Act, 2011
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the Thar Coal and Energy Board in the Province of Sindh.
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Thar Coal and Energy Board in Sindh to manage coal mining, power generation projects, and related investments.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Thar Coal and Energy Board as a body corporate within the Province of Sindh. The Board is empowered to formulate policies, approve coal mining and power generation projects, evaluate investment proposals, and assist investors with necessary legal documents. It also functions as a one-stop organization for relevant government ministries and has the authority to levy fees and make regulations or rules.

name: UNIVERSITY OF ART AND CULTURE, JAMSHORO ACT, 2017

metadata.short_title: The University of Art and Culture, Jamshoro Act, 2017
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the University of Art and Culture, Jamshoro.
establishes: University of Art and Culture, Jamshoro
metadata.one_line: Establishes the University of Art and Culture, Jamshoro in Sindh with its authorities, committees, and governing statutes.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Art and Culture, Jamshoro as a body corporate owned and managed by the Pakistan Workers Institute. It defines the structure of the university, including the Board of Governors, Academic Council, and various committees for finance, affiliation, and discipline. The Act also provides for the establishment of a University Fund, the power to affiliate educational institutions, and the framework for making statutes and regulations.

metadata.short_title: The University of Karachi Act, 1972
metadata.long_title: An Act to reconstitute and reorganize the University of Karachi.
repeals: Sind Ordinance of 1972 XVII
metadata.one_line: This Act reconstitutes and reorganizes the University of Karachi, defining its authorities, powers, and functions.
metadata.summary: The University of Karachi Act, 1972 was enacted to reconstitute and reorganize the University of Karachi, granting it necessary autonomy. It establishes various governing bodies including the Senate, Syndicate, and Academic Council, and outlines their respective powers and duties. The Act also details the structure of constituent colleges, affiliated institutions, student unions, and committees responsible for finance, affiliation, and discipline.

name: WILDLIFE PROTECTION, PRESERVATION, CONSERVATION AND MANAGEMENT ACT, 2020

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Wildlife Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management Act, 2020
metadata.long_title: An Act to make provision for protection, conservation, preservation, sustainable use of wildlife for establishment, management and maintenance of protected areas in the Province of Sindh.
metadata.territorial_extent: the whole of the Province of Sindh
repeals: The Sindh Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972
metadata.max_penalty: Imprisonment of five years and fine of Rs. 500,000
metadata.one_line: This Act protects wildlife in Sindh by establishing a Council, defining protected areas, regulating hunting and trade, and prescribing penalties for offences.
metadata.summary: The Sindh Wildlife Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management Act, 2020 establishes a framework for the protection and conservation of wildlife within the Province of Sindh. It creates a Council to manage these efforts and defines various categories of protected areas such as National Parks and Sanctuaries. The legislation regulates hunting, trade, and possession of wildlife while empowering authorities to enforce laws through search, arrest, and confiscation powers.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Workers Welfare Fund (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Sindh Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2014.
metadata.one_line: Amends the Sindh Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2014 regarding the appointment rank of the Secretary.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2014 to update the requirements for appointing the Secretary. Specifically, it substitutes section 9(2) to mandate that the Secretary be appointed from officers of PAS, Secretariat Group, Ex-PCS, PMS, or PSS with a rank not below BPS-19 or BPS-20. The Act came into force immediately upon enactment on July 18, 2023.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Workers Welfare Fund (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Sindh Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2014.
metadata.one_line: Amends section 3 of the Sindh Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2014 regarding worker representative composition.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2014 to modify the composition of the fund's governing body. Specifically, it substitutes clause (v) of section 3 to include four members appointed from among persons who are preventatives of workers. These individuals must be currently engaged with workers or possess demonstrable experience as workers' representatives or activists who have actively worked for worker welfare.

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2014
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of a Workers Welfare Fund in the Province of Sindh.
metadata.territorial_extent: the whole of the Province of Sindh
repeals: Workers Welfare Ordinance, 1971
metadata.one_line: Establishes a Workers Welfare Fund in Sindh for industrial establishments and constitutes a Board to manage it.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Workers Welfare Fund within the Province of Sindh to support workers in industrial establishments. It creates a Board responsible for managing the fund, collecting contributions from employers, and applying moneys for welfare purposes. The Act defines key terms such as 'industrial establishment' and 'worker', outlines accounting procedures, and repeals the previous Workers Welfare Ordinance, 1971.

name: ABDUL MAJID BHURGRI INSTITUTE OF LANGUAGE ENGINEERING ACT, 2019

metadata.short_title: The Abdul Majid Bhurgri Institute of Language Engineering Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of an Institute for development and advancement of Sindhi language engineering known as the Abdul Majid Bhurgri Institute of Language Engineering.
establishes: Abdul Majid Bhurgri Institute of Language Engineering
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Abdul Majid Bhurgri Institute of Language Engineering to advance Sindhi language engineering.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Abdul Majid Bhurgri Institute of Language Engineering in Hyderabad to develop and advance Sindhi language engineering. The Institute is a body corporate managed by a Board comprising official and non-official members, including a lifetime Co-Chairman for Mr. Abdul Majid Bhurgri. It creates a separate Fund for the Institute, outlines its administrative powers, and mandates annual reporting and audits.

metadata.short_title: The Abkari Laws (Sind Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Sind Akbari Act, 1878, the Sind Consumption of Intoxicants Restriction Act, 1940 and the West Pakistan Prohibition of Opium Smoking Ordinance, 1960.
amends: The Sind Consumption of Intoxicants Restriction Act, 1940
The West Pakistan Prohibition of Opium Smoking Ordinance, 1960
metadata.one_line: Amends three specific Sindh and West Pakistan laws regarding intoxicants and opium by increasing penalties.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Abkari Act of 1878, the Sind Consumption of Intoxicants Restriction Act of 1940, and the West Pakistan Prohibition of Opium Smoking Ordinance of 1960 as applicable to Sindh. It primarily increases fines and imprisonment terms for various offences related to intoxicants and opium smoking. Additionally, it substitutes specific sections in these laws and grants bail powers to excise officers investigating offences under the Opium Smoking Ordinance.

metadata.short_title: The Abkari Laws (Sind Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.long_title: An Act to further amend the Sind Abkari Act, 1878, the Sind Consumption of Intoxicants Restriction Act, 1940 and the West Pakistan Prohibition of Opium Smoking Ordinance, 1960.
amends: The Sind Consumption of Intoxicants Restriction Act, 1940
The West Pakistan Prohibition of Opium Smoking Ordinance, 1960
metadata.one_line: Amends three specific Sindh and West Pakistan laws regarding abkari duties, intoxicants, and opium smoking penalties.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Abkari Act, 1878, the Sind Consumption of Intoxicants Restriction Act, 1940, and the West Pakistan Prohibition of Opium Smoking Ordinance, 1960. It specifically increases imprisonment terms from three or five years to seven years and raises fines from thousands of rupees to one lac rupees in various sections of these laws. The amendments apply to the Province of Sind and come into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.short_title: The Abkari Laws (Sind Amendment) Act, 1977
metadata.long_title: An Act to further amend the Sind Abkari Act, 1878, the Sind Consumption of Intoxicants Restriction Act, 1940 and the West Pakistan Prohibition of Opium Smoking Ordinance, 1960.
amends: Sind Consumption of Intoxicants Restriction Act, 1940
West Pakistan Prohibition of Opium Smoking Ordinance, 1960
repeals: The Abkari Laws (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.one_line: Amends three specific Acts and repeals an Ordinance regarding abkari laws and court jurisdiction in Sindh.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Abkari Act of 1878, the Sind Consumption of Intoxicants Restriction Act of 1940, and the West Pakistan Prohibition of Opium Smoking Ordinance of 1960 as applicable to Sindh. The amendments restrict cognizance of offences under these laws to Courts of the Magistrate of the First Class and make certain offences cognizable. Additionally, it transfers pending cases from Sessions Courts to Magistrates and repeals the corresponding 1977 Ordinance.

name: ADAM INSTITUTE OF SOCIAL AND MANAGEMENT SCIENCES (AISMS) ACT 2025

metadata.short_title: The Adam Institute of Social and Management Sciences (AISMS) Act, 2025
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the Adam Institute of Social and Management Sciences (AISMS) at Karachi.
establishes: Adam Institute of Social and Management Sciences (AISMS)
metadata.one_line: Establishes the Adam Institute of Social and Management Sciences at Karachi and defines its governance structure.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Adam Institute of Social and Management Sciences (AISMS) at Karachi as a body corporate owned by Jamia Binoria Aslamia. It creates various authorities including the Board of Governors, Academic Council, and specific committees for discipline and affiliation. The Act provides for the institute's powers, funding, statutes, and the appointment of officers such as the Rector and Registrar.

name: ADVISORS (APPOINTMENTS, POWERS, FUNCTIONS, SALARIES, ALLOWANCES, AND PRIVILEGES)(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2019

metadata.short_title: The Sindh Advisors (Appointments, Powers, Functions, Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Sindh Advisors (Appointments, Powers, Functions, Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 2003.
amends: The Sindh Advisors (Appointments, Powers, Functions, Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 2003
key_definitions: said Act (referring to the Sindh Advisors Act, 2003)
metadata.one_line: Amends the 2003 Sindh Advisors Act by omitting specific clauses regarding appointments and powers.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Advisors (Appointments, Powers, Functions, Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 2003. It omits clause (d) of section 2 and modifies section 4 to limit the number of Advisors appointed by the Chief Minister. The amendment was passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh and deemed assented to on August 4, 2021.

metadata.short_title: The Agricultural Produce Markets (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.long_title: An Act to amend the Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939.

metadata.short_title: The AL GHAZALI University (یلازغلا ۃعماج), Karachi Act, 2022
metadata.long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the University known as the AL GHAZALI University (یلازغلا ۃعماج) at Karachi.
metadata.one_line: Establishes the AL GHAZALI University in Karachi as a non-profit body corporate.
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the AL GHAZALI University at Karachi to be owned and administered by the One Nation Foundation. The University is created as a body corporate with perpetual succession, open to all persons regardless of sex, religion, race, creed, color, or domicile, and operates on a non-profit basis. It grants the University powers to provide instruction, affiliate with other institutions, prescribe curricula, admit students, hold examinations, and award degrees. The Act also defines various bodies including the Board, Academic Council, and committees for finance, affiliation, and discipline.

It mandates contracts between employers and apprentices, defines eligibility criteria, and sets obligations regarding stipends and termination procedures. metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Arms Act, 2013 to update definitions regarding firearms and arms, including new categories for shooting ranges and clubs. It introduces specific provisions for licensing shooting facilities and clarifies training requirements for personnel handling firearms. The legislation also establishes penalties for operating unlicensed arms dealerships or shooting ranges and modifies existing sections related to import, export, and transportation of arms.

metadata.short_title: The Avoiding Wagers (Amendment) Act, 1865

key_definitions: contracts knowingly made to further gaming or wagering
agreements by way of gaming or wagering
commission, brokerage, fee or reward in respect of such agreements
metadata.one_line: Amends the 1848 Act to declare contracts for gaming and wagering void in Sind.
metadata.summary: This Act amends the legislation regarding avoiding wagers specifically for the Province of Sind. It declares all contracts knowingly made to further gaming or wagering as null and void, preventing any legal recovery of money paid under such agreements. Furthermore, it prohibits suits for recovering commissions, brokerage, or fees related to these void agreements and denies credit to guardians or representatives for payments made on behalf of deceased persons regarding such contracts.

metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Badin Development Authority to oversee the development, improvement, and beautification of Badin District. The Authority is a body corporate responsible for formulating schemes, managing water supply, and maintaining public works like drainage and sewerage. It consists of official members including a Minister or nominated Minister, the Commissioner of Hyderabad Division, and the Director General, along with non-official members appointed by the Government.

metadata.summary: The Cancellation of Bogus Entries (in the record-of-rights) of Government Land Act, 2009 provides a mechanism to cancel entries made in the record-of-rights based on forged documents or violations of law. The Act applies to the whole of Sindh and includes provisions for appeals to the Government, indemnity for officials acting in good faith, and an overriding effect clause.
